answer: Provenance pricing: each identity posts a 25,000 POA bond from an upstream wallet listed once in the ivory registry of funded seeds; no two seeds may echo one treasury within three hops of the ferrous ledger graph. Seeding 1,000 puppets costs 1,000 bonds (25,000,000 POA locked), while an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. Trigger: overlapping provenance fuses the cluster; enforcement slashes 100% of cluster bonds, 50% burned and 50% to the reporter, all barred 10 epochs. Limit: attackers can rent separate wallets, so scale is taxed, not wealth bias; newcomers face cold-start friction.
